abstract: Gestational trophoblastic diseases (GTD) is an abnormal condition of the placenta, the incidence of which is very high in the State of Kerala, India. Placentae of normal (50) and molar pregnancy (122) including 52 showing persistent disease were used for the study. EGFR and EGF expression was analyzed by immunohistochemistry using monoclonal antibodies. EGF receptors were quantitated using the I-125 EGF-binding assay and that of EGF was quantitated using isotope labelled antibody to EGF. Tumours with histological diagnosis of invasive moles and choriocarcinoma showed very strong binding of both EGF and EGFR. The present observations also suggest the possibility of presence of mutated EGF receptors in persistent trophoblastic disease.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）は胎盤の異常な状態であり、インド・ケララ州では発生率が非常に高い。正常胎盤50例、胞状奇胎122例（持続性疾患52例を含む）を検体として用いた。EGFRの発現を、モノクローナル抗体を用いた免疫組織化学で解析した。EGF受容体は125I-EGF結合アッセイで定量し、EGFはアイソトープ標識抗EGF抗体を用いて定量した。組織学的に侵入奇胎および絨毛癌と診断された腫瘍は、EGFとEGFRの双方で非常に強い結合を示した。本研究はまた、持続性栄養膜疾患では変異したEGF受容体が存在する可能性を示唆する。
